items.summary: Google Trends set its five-year high for "prediction market" the week the 2026 World Cup opened, and its single-day high on the day of the final. Category volume hit a record in July. August is pacing lower on both, and Polymarket is falling behind Kalshi faster than the mindshare data suggests.

items.title: Stripe Is Acquiring AI Router OpenRouter for +$8B
items.summary: OpenRouter's founder built OpenSea, then built "Stripe for AI." Now Stripe is buying the company in a massive deal.

items.title: Ansem Debuts Launchpad and the z500 Onchain Index
items.summary: A new Solana launchpad and onchain index from trader Ansem builds atop the $ANSEM token.
